address: via Pralongo 216, Monastier di Treviso, 31050, Italy
bio: Menegaldo is a long-established favourite for anyone who loves authentic fish dishes made from top-quality ingredients. Although it feels as though time has stood still in the pleasantly old-fashioned dining room, with its outmoded decor and furnishings, the service here is attentive and enthusiastic. The dishes are traditional and typical of the area, making this an excellent choice for delicious seafood cuisine that is elaborate without being overly fussy....
